    About FNPF

    Securing the retirement of Fiji's workers since 1966

    As Fiji's national superannuation fund, we grow members' savings through sound investment, so every worker can look forward to a secure retirement.

    • Grow your savings. Interest is credited to your account every year.
    • Support for life's moments. Education, medical, housing, funeral and more.
    • Income in retirement. Lump sum, pension, annuity or drawdown.
    More about FNPF
    FNPF in 2026
    9.5%Interest credited to members
    $866mCredited to member accounts
    446,000+Members and DrawDown holders
    $12.1bTotal fund assets FY2025 · Member Fund $9.5b

    Services built around you. Start with who you are and we'll show you the way.

    Grow your savings and access them when life calls for it

    Join as a compulsory or voluntary member, keep your details and nominees up to date, and manage everything online.

    • Compulsory and voluntary membership
    • Save for your child from any age
    • Portal, myFNPF app and *567#
    Member services

    Popular for members

    Voluntary membershipFor self-employed and informal workers WithdrawalsEducation, medical, housing and more NominationsChoose who receives your savings Grow your savingsContribute more than 8%

    Turn your savings into income that lasts

    At 55 you can take a lump sum or choose a Life Pension, Term Annuity or DrawDown Account, or a mix of them.

    • Compare every retirement option side by side
    • Transfer savings to a loved one's account
    • Manage payments and renewal certificates online
    Retirement services

    Popular for retirees

    Compare your optionsLump sum, pension, annuity, drawdown Life PensionA regular monthly payment for life Term AnnuityFixed terms of 5, 10 or 15 years Renewal certificatePensioner services

    Register, add employees and pay contributions on time

    Every business in Fiji with employees must register with FNPF and pay monthly contributions for its staff.

    • Registration requirements by business type
    • Schedules and invoices in the employer portal
    • Reward staff with additional contributions
    Employer services

    Popular for employers

    Register your businessDocuments by business type Register employeesNew staff aged 15 and over Contribution ratesCurrent employee and employer rates How to payCashier or bank transfer

    We're here to help when someone has passed away

    Let us know about a member's death, claim as a nominee, and get help with funeral costs. Our team will guide you through each step.

    • Notify FNPF with the Advice of Death form
    • Nominee claims and pension options for spouses
    • Special Death Benefit of up to $2,000
    Get support

    Where to start

    Notify us of a deathFW02 Advice of Death Make a nominee claimFW02N Nominee Claim Funeral assistanceUp to $2,000 per funeral Talk to us330 7811 · 5857 from mobile

    Access your savings
    when you need them

    See what each withdrawal covers, how much you can access and how quickly it's processed.

    Eligibility checker

    Which withdrawal fits your situation?

    A guide only. FNPF confirms eligibility when you apply.

    Education

    Tuition, textbooks, laptops and accommodation for your family.

    Accommodation
    Up to $2,500/sem
    Processing
    3 working days

    Medical

    Emergency treatment locally or overseas, paid to the provider.

    Overseas incidentals
    Up to $10,000
    Processing
    5 working days

    Funeral

    Help with funeral costs for your spouse, parents, siblings or children.

    Limit
    $2,000 per funeral
    Processing
    3 working days

    Unemployment

    Support from your General Account if you've lost your job.

    Amount
    $100 to $2,000
    Frequency
    Once in 12 months

    Village housing

    Build, extend, renovate, repair, or add solar, power or water tanks.

    Quick repairs
    $1,000 to $5,000
    Build
    From $15,000

    Urban housing

    Buy land or a home, build, renovate, or reduce your home loan.

    Reduce home loan
    Min. 10% of loan
    Preserved access
    Up to 21%, once

    Retirement at 55

    Withdraw your full balance or choose a pension, annuity or drawdown.

    Entitlement
    Full balance
    Age
    55 and over

    Low balance account

    For members with a small balance who have been out of work.

    Balance
    $10,000 or less
    Age
    50 to 54

    Migration

    For members leaving Fiji permanently, and expatriates finishing work here.

    Entitlement
    Full balance
    Payment
    Lump sum only

    Medical incapacity

    If a physical or mental condition means you can no longer work.

    Assessed by
    FNPF Medical Board
    Entitlement
    Full balance

    When a member dies

    Advice of death, nominee claims and the Special Death Benefit.

    Death benefit
    Up to $2,000
    Apply within
    20 working days

    Further payments

    Contributions credited after your full withdrawal was paid.

    Request
    In writing
    Paid to
    Local or overseas bank
    View all withdrawals
